_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Surround ing sahiji {width}x{height} grid.
Sampeyan iku player {player_id}. Langkah-langkah kang sah: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' utawa w/s/a/d.
Tujuan: urip luwih dawa ketimbang liyané. Jejak-jejak iku mematikan; tabrakan karo témbok nganti pati; tabrakan sirung kang padha nganti pati kaloroné.

game_action.invalid_death: Pemain {player_id} tilar donya amarga pamindhahan sing ora valid.

outcome.outlived: Pemain sing luwih urip tinimbang liyane.
outcome.turn_limit: Watesan giliran wis tekan - sing paling dawa menang.
